//: A glob, not a hand-kept list: a module missing from the old list was only
checked when something else happened to import it, and a new module was
unchecked until someone remembered to add it.
The render worker is the one exclusion: it runs in a Worker scope, so it is
checked by tsconfig.worker.json against the WebWorker lib instead (the two
libs declare conflicting globals and cannot share a program).
A TypeScript module (scripts/html-ts-modules.mjs) matches both globs, as
x.ts and its emitted x.js; TypeScript keeps x.ts and drops x.js, so the
emitted file is never checked. The .ts modules are checked here and, with
projectm-pcm-bridge.js (the FLAC/MOD player shells' PCM producer, also used by
projectm-display-capture.js) lives at the html root, not under flac-player/,
for exactly this reason: a file outside the glob is invisible to the checker.
